subject.title: feat: add opt-in telemetry for Windows node tool calls

question: Should the repository adopt this node-tool telemetry taxonomy, including the `legacy` or `v2` approval-pipeline attribute and failure-only log export, as a supported operator-facing contract?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally additive and privacy-bounded, but the permanence, naming, and remote-export value of a new operational telemetry contract are product and observability-policy choices rather than a mechanical code decision.

options.title: Approve the bounded contract
options.body: Accept the documented finite telemetry taxonomy after current-head collector proof confirms both local MCP and gateway behavior.

options.title: Narrow the exported contract
options.body: Require removal or renaming of fields that maintainers do not want to support before requesting final proof.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer node-tool telemetry until a broader observability direction is established for Windows-node diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded contract
recommendation.body: Accept the documented finite telemetry taxonomy after current-head collector proof confirms both local MCP and gateway behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Most likely adjacent owner for Windows-node command execution and its operator-facing diagnostic contract based on available repository history.
